content.text: Submitted. The repaired redline keeps the locked **deviation** status and makes a single minimal edit to 21.1: limb (a) now reads "the Fees paid or payable by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve months preceding the event giving rise to the claim", with the USD 1,000,000 floor added as limb (b). The over-broad "all amounts" / "and all Order Forms" language is removed, and the mutual cap sentence, the mutual indirect/consequential damages exclusion in 21.2 and the Excluded Claims carve-outs in 21.3 (which already supply the remaining preferred elements) are untouched.
